scope: Ideal subcritical water Rankine and single-reheat recipes in the existing custom-cycle editor; 30 tool routes retained.

features.pressure_order: 0 < condenser < boiler < 22.064 MPa; reheat pressure strictly between condenser and boiler
features.pump: exact isentropic ps inverse, no v*dp replacement
features.checks: enthalpy heat/work plus discrepancies against independent path integrals; algebraic total residual explicitly distinguished
features.quality: x and 1-x only when defined; superheated exits and their comparison deltas remain null
features.comparison: frozen A/B, six common-range overlays, pump/turbine/reheat/exit-quality rows
exports: UK/EN study reports with A/B component tables
features.background: existing Worker, hard cancellation, edit/navigation revision guards; invalid inputs retain last verified cycle

numerical.independent_package: Python iapws 1.5.5, GPL-3.0, reference generation only
numerical.reference_inverse: saturation lever rule or scipy brentq on independent s(T,P), with entropy residual check; no application results used
numerical.integration: grid cap increased 1024 to 4096; unchanged tolerances and refinement/residual criteria; no algebraic integral correction

checks.chromium: passed final Rankine scenario, including component rows with no accidental state-selection buttons
checks.firefox: passed final Rankine scenario and offline standalone reheat
checks.gas_library_regression: passed Chromium and Firefox, including offline standalone
checks.cross_browser: all 30 tools, UK/EN, HTML/JSON, restore and 320/390/768 px passed in Chromium 154 and Firefox 157 before selector-only UI fix
checks.calculator_async: passed Chromium and Firefox on final build, including real IAPWS95 search, cancellation/import/restore/offline/retry
checks.release_core: all 14 checks passed on final build: 790 unit tests, water/transport/reactor software checks, deterministic build and package, ZIP integrity
checks.water_process_regression: passed Chromium and Firefox, including both water models, cancellation and offline standalone

limitations: No regeneration, supercritical recipes, irreversible component efficiencies, pressure losses or optimization
IF97 consistency-overlap ambiguities are rejected, including the tested 1073.15 K region-boundary recipe
Moisture is not a turbine suitability criterion
No Safari or physical device touch validation
Existing reactor-cell physical screening remains failed; this water-cycle sprint makes no new neutron-model validation claim
publication: not published; full GitHub CI and Pages deployment are a separate step
